public_research_examples.public_query: site:justice.gov money mule initiative online job offers receive forward money virtual currency
public_research_examples.reference_title: U.S. Department of Justice: Money Mule Initiative
public_research_examples.research_question: How do money-mule recruiters use remote job offers and virtual currency, and what should an analyst verify before assuming the account holder knowingly participated?
public_research_examples.expected_context: The published DOJ guidance describes ill-defined jobs, money arriving from strangers, onward transfers and virtual currency. It explains that some participants are deceived. This is general context, not evidence about this fictional customer or exchange.
public_research_examples.query_boundary: Only the fixed public_query is suitable for the public-web step. Do not send the alert ID, customer identity, account details, transactions or recruitment-message text.
